title: [R3] Unhandled errors in Chat/set result.type leave user without feedback
description:
In openOrCreateChat (line 198), error handling only checks for result.notCreated. But if Chat/set fails with result.type error (e.g., 'serverFailure'), the code proceeds without showing error message.

Then at line 203: const newChat = result.created.c0
result.created is undefined, TypeError is thrown and caught by outer try-catch (line 205), but error message passed to showError is just err.message which may be unhelpful.

Symptom: Chat creation fails silently or with generic error message instead of specific JMAP error.

Fix: Check for result.type error first:
  if (result.type) throw new Error('Chat/set error: ' + result.type);
